description: Edit an existing project build rule in place. Takes the id from `convention_list`, preserves that id, and replaces the rule and optional module scope. Omit `module` to make the edited rule project-wide. Existing handoffs are unaffected; future builds use the updated rule.

module.description: Optional replacement module scope. Omit to make the rule project-wide.

project.description: Project id (UUID) or slug to target for THIS call only. Must be a project on your account.

rule.description: The replacement rule in plain language. Max 2000 characters.

name: convention_edit
